report_name: Data Leak Exposes 41,000 DHS Employees and Contractors

threat_actors.name: Distributed Denial of Secrets
threat_actors.description: An activist group that published the personal and operational data of over 41,000 U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) employees and contractors on November 1, 2026.
threat_actors.goals: Public exposure of sensitive government information.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Web Service
attack_patterns.description: The activist group Distributed Denial of Secrets published the leaked dataset of DHS personnel data on a public-facing online platform.

identities.name: U.S. Department of Homeland Security
identities.description: U.S. federal executive department whose employees and contractors were the victims of a major data leak. The leak affected over 41,000 personnel from components including CISA, ICE, CBP, and HSI.

identities.name: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency
identities.description: A component agency of the DHS whose personnel data was exposed in the leak. Also known as CISA.

identities.name: Immigration and Customs Enforcement
identities.description: A component agency of the DHS whose personnel data was exposed in the leak. Also known as ICE.

identities.name: Customs and Border Protection
identities.description: A component agency of the DHS whose personnel data was exposed in the leak. Also known as CBP.

identities.name: Homeland Security Investigations
identities.description: A component agency of the DHS whose personnel data was exposed in the leak. Also known as HSI.

infrastructure.name: Distributed Denial of Secrets Public Data Repository
infrastructure.description: A public-facing online repository used by the activist group 'Distributed Denial of Secrets' to publish the leaked data of DHS personnel.

relationships.target_name: Distributed Denial of Secrets Public Data Repository
